svg.title: Canisters fired from a moving spaceship
svg.desc: Left: a spaceship moving toward Earth at v = 0.50c fires a canister forward, toward Earth, at u′ = 0.75c relative to the ship, while an observer stands on Earth. Right: the same ship, still moving toward Earth at v = 0.50c, fires the canister backward, away from Earth, at u′ = −0.75c relative to the ship. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Relativistic velocity addition keeps subluminal speeds below c
Forward launch: u′ = 0.75c in the ship frame
u/c = (v/c + u′/c)/(1 + vu′/c²). The gold classical sum is a comparison, not a possible launch speed.
Light remains at c for every ship speed shown.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
